latency.measured: external monotonic_ns immediately before launching host with ordinary prompt, through full terminal turn.completed JSON line receipt after final agent_message; timestamp precedes terminal JSON parse. Includes startup, queueing, tools, reasoning and generation.
latency.observer_source: observer.py.txt (one-off standard-library collection glue, not an Audit dependency or timing service)
latency.event_ledgers: events/; stdout content omitted in published ledgers, hashes retained; complete raw anonymized final responses in audits/ and grades/
latency.recording: float seconds from nanosecond monotonic readings, published summaries rounded to 0.001s; clock resolution 4.166666666666666e-08s is not an accuracy claim; scheduling, buffering and preceding event handling included; the terminal-line timestamp precedes its JSON parse
latency.not_measured: UI rendering, isolated serial latency, repeatability, monetary cost, human comprehension time
latency.actionability: timed receipt of each grader ACTIONABILITY message after reading report only; startup included. Field identification and clarity are subjective LLM judgments, not a two-minute human usability result

setup.grading_and_second_review_seconds: separate timings/ records; overlapping intervals are not human labor or wall-clock totals
setup.clarification: the expert preparer selected scopes and staged sources; this does not measure a novice whole-repository experience

normalization.path_prefixes: /FAULTLINE, /SNAPSHOTS, /SOURCES, /EVALUATION, /GRADING, /HOST_CONFIG replace task-local/host paths; wording unchanged otherwise
normalization.sessions: thread identifiers replaced with SESSION in event ledgers
normalization.identities: freeze.json retains original input digests; published-inputs.json separately binds normalized prompt bytes. expectations and source-manifest bytes are unchanged
normalization.outputs: command stdout retained locally; published event ledger stores normalized output SHA256/byte count rather than vendoring upstream source. Raw findings and grading text retained with path normalization. Screen files normalize trailing newlines.

limitations: Purposive Python-only scopes; four single runs, no matched ordinary-review comparison, no statistical reliability claim.
Public historical fixes may be familiar to model training; withholding answers does not prove the cases were unseen.
